about: Fluvy’s cards as data, generated from the cards’ editors by `pnpm docs:cards`. A card is `type` plus any of its `keys`; `does` says what a key does, `label` and `helper` are the editor’s words for it, `default` what the card does when the key is left out (never written by the editor), `values` a choice’s values with the editor’s word for each. `lists` are edited item by item: an item is the `id` field alone (a bare entity id) or a map with it and any of `item`. `example` draws the pictures; `layouts` are the example with one more key each, `layout_pictures` the picture of each; `demo` opens the example in the live demo. Paths are relative to docs/.
